source_references.meaning: fail_safe loaded from parameter only at initialization
EMERGENCY_STOP calls abort once, later requires enable_fail_safe and low base velocity to replan
Safety callback immediately returns in EMERGENCY_STOP
Depth loss sets enable_fail_safe false; does not clear target
Explicit accepted new goal changes state to GEN_NEW_TRAJ, not reset fail_safe
Map health automatically clears its own transient timeout and logs recovery

minimal_repair_boundary: Do not change runtime code in this analysis. A later fix must separate configured fail_safe policy from transient sensor-stop cause, hold zero until live sensor and measured-state validity recover, require current ESDF and validated new trajectory, preserve non-sensor stop owners, and never replay the aborted old trajectory. Removing only enable_fail_safe_=false is insufficient because current EMERGENCY_STOP auto-recovery has no live sensor-health condition.
